summary: Implement an authorized structural refactor in reversible, behavior-preserving, independently verified increments.

prerequisites: Define the authorized refactor boundary and the observable behavior that must remain stable.
outcomes: Protect behavior with a verified baseline before changing internal structure.
Keep refactoring separate from features, bug fixes, formatting, and adjacent cleanup.

scenarios.title: Extract one responsibility
scenarios.prompt: Use the refactor-safely skill to move this parsing responsibility without changing the command's behavior.
scenarios.outcome: The change lands in small tested increments and preserves every protected contract.

scenarios.title: Separate a discovered defect
scenarios.prompt: Use the refactor-safely skill when a characterization test exposes an existing product bug during the refactor.
scenarios.outcome: The defect is separated from the structural work instead of silently choosing new behavior.
